notes.title: Super Seducer 1 Updated with some Features from Super Seducer 3
notes.notes:
Dear Super Seducer,

We are making some big updates to Super Seducer 1 and 2.   These were supposed to be done to celebrate the launch of Super Seducer 3, but unfortunately that game was banned by Steam.  We decided to still go ahead with the updates, they include:

-Adding the "Custom Game" options from SS3
-Updating and improving the Twitch Integration.
-Updating the latest version of Unity.

and more!  

Thank you for your support since 2018 with these Super Seducer games.  We had lots of difficult times and your support really helped us get through them.  

Regards,

Richard

[url=https://twitter.com/RichardGambler]Follow me on Twitter for the latest news.  [/url]

notes.title: Twitch Integration and Korean language added today!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

Big update today!  We have added Twitch integration to both Super Seducer 1 and 2.  

Here are the instructions:  
https://www.puatraining.com/superseducer/twitch/

We also noticed that the game was recently a hit in Korea so we've added Korean language support.  Credit to 되는닉네임이뭔데  for the translation :)  I've been to Seoul twice and really like Korean movies so was happy to see the game do well there :)  

I'm also getting lots of questions about Super Seducer 3...what to say? Well we are working on it, it's going to be great...and when I have news I'll announce it on Twitter.  Wishlists are open on Steam.  

Thanks to all the Super Seducer fans for the support, good reviews, positive comments, and overall support, it's all much appreciated by me and our small team!

Rich

notes.title: Super Seducer 2 out now (discount for buyers of SS1)
notes.notes:
Hey Guys, 

Super Seducer 2 is out today and we have arranged a launch discount AND an additional discount for buyers of the original :)

Get it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/863570/Super_Seducer_2/]here[/url] 

1.  Super Seducer 2 is much longer, with 16 hours total play-time.
2.  SS2 is much better - we have a bigger and better cast, more varied scenarios, and everything looks and sounds better. 
3.  The advice and seduction tactics are turned up and cover a wider range of common questions that single guys have.  

Overall we tried to add more of what you loved in the first game, and fix anything that you said could be better!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/863570/Super_Seducer_2/

Finally, I want to thank all of you for supporting this franchise :)

Rich

notes.title: Super Seducer is a blancmange of ineptitude and misogyny
notes.notes:
Super Seducer is a game made by self-described “pick-up artist” (PUA) Richard La Ruina, aimed at teaching straight men so-called seduction techniques for attracting women. The result is a farcical and disastrous laughing stock of a game. But PUAs aren t a funny joke, rather they’re a frightening reality of a deeply misogynistic culture that in its less PR-friendly moments has frequently advocated sexual assault against women.

Super Seducer is clearly intended to be part of the PR exercise, an attempt to portray PUAs as just guys looking for ways to convince girls to like them, albeit through techniques that are primarily focused around lying and manipulation. It s an attempt to put a friendly mask on an ugly face. What s so peculiar about it is that it’s not only bad at its attempts to do this, but it s cringingly bad at everything. (more…)
